Summary: CI pipeline: lint, pytest, frontend build on every pull request
Description: GitHub Actions with a Postgres service container.
Acceptance criteria: Failing tests block the PR; badge in README.

Summary: Frontend scaffold: Next.js, TypeScript, layout, typed API client
Description: App Router, route groups (public, app, admin), client generated from the backend OpenAPI schema; add the frontend service to the existing Docker Compose file.
Acceptance criteria: Landing page renders; client regenerates with one command.

Description: ruff/black (or equivalent), eslint/prettier, pre-commit and a secrets scan in CI.
Acceptance criteria: Repository scan finds no keys; CI fails on a planted dummy key.

Summary: API contract v1 agreed between both members
Description: Endpoints, request/response shapes and error format for profile, catalog, eligibility, roadmap, advisor and admin. Written as OpenAPI plus an ADR. Lets frontend and AI work proceed in parallel against mocks.
Acceptance criteria: Contract merged and reviewed by the other member; mock server or stub routes available.

Summary: Schema v1: University, Program, Requirement, Source, Deadline
Description: Requirement stores type, operator, value, pathway, source reference, source tier, status, verification date and validity date; required documents of a programme are requirement records too (no document upload). Source stores URL, tier, content hash, last fetched.
Acceptance criteria: Migration applies; DB constraints reject a requirement without source or status.

Description: Pure Python: five statuses, allowed transitions, rule that only Tier 1 may produce Verified, validity window (180 days for requirements, end of cycle for deadlines). Injected clock.
Acceptance criteria: Unit tests cover every transition and every forbidden transition.

Summary: Pilot dataset selection criteria and programme list
Description: Choose the 20 pilot programmes across Bachelor's, Master's and Doctoral/PhD levels in Kazakhstan and the United States (objective O2, outcome D2), about 8 requirement types each, with Tier 1 sources available. Fix the data snapshot date.
Acceptance criteria: List of 20 programmes documented with level, country and official source pages; the work is split between both members (10 each).

Description: Operators (>=, <=, equals, in, exists), value types and units, GPA scales, language-test equivalence per admission pathway, how pending items (e.g. exam not yet taken) are represented.
Acceptance criteria: ADR reviewed by the other member and the supervisor; examples for all pilot requirement types.

Description: JSON schema for degree, field, country, GPA, language score, intake, budget; required vs optional fields; follow-up question templates.
Acceptance criteria: Schema validated against 5 sample dialogues; versioned in src/ai.

Summary: Schema v2: profile, chat, application, eligibility, roadmap, knowledge chunk, audit
Description: ApplicantProfile, ChatMessage, Application, EligibilityResult, Roadmap, RoadmapTask, KnowledgeChunk (text and tsvector column), StatusChangeLog, User.
Acceptance criteria: Entities match the ERD; migration applies; indexes for status and programme lookups.

Description: Every transition writes who, when, from, to and reason.
Acceptance criteria: A record can move through its life cycle and each change is logged.

Summary: Source archive: page snapshots with content hash
Description: Store snapshot and hash for each registered Tier 1 source so a requirement can be traced to the content it was verified against.
Acceptance criteria: Requirement detail returns snapshot reference; changed content produces a different hash.

Summary: Synthetic seed fixtures for tests and demos
Description: Clearly fake programmes and profiles covering every status. Never mixed with the pilot dataset.
Acceptance criteria: Fixtures load with one command; marked synthetic in the data.

Summary: Registration, login, password hashing and JWT
Description: Hashed passwords, short-lived access token, refresh strategy documented.
Acceptance criteria: Passwords never stored or logged in clear; invalid tokens rejected.

Description: Dependencies/guards on every route; permission matrix test.
Acceptance criteria: Request to another role's API returns 403; matrix test covers every route.

Description: Create/edit requirements with validation against the rule model; new records start as Unverified.
Acceptance criteria: Invalid operator/value rejected; only admin role can write.

Description: Requirements with Tier 1 URL, type, operator, value, pathway, verification date for Dinara's assigned programmes.
Acceptance criteria: 100% of entered requirements have source and status.

Description: Same as T-17 for Artur's assigned programmes.
Acceptance criteria: 100% of entered requirements have source and status.

Description: Abstract client, pinned model version in config, timeouts, retries, token/cost logging, deterministic fake for tests.
Acceptance criteria: Provider swap needs only config; tests run without network.

Summary: Onboarding service: extraction and follow-up questions
Description: Chat endpoint that extracts the structured profile from free text and asks for each missing required field.
Acceptance criteria: Each missing required field triggers a question; extracted values validated against the schema.

Summary: Extraction test set: 20 dialogues with gold fields
Description: Synthetic dialogues, two annotators for the gold values.
Acceptance criteria: At least 85% of stated fields extracted correctly (target to confirm with the supervisor).

Summary: App shell and UI kit: layout, navigation, StatusBadge, SourceChip, ExplanationRow
Description: Core components that show status, source and verification date consistently. Unknown/Stale never rendered green. Colour is never the only signal.
Acceptance criteria: Storybook-style page or demo route showing all five statuses and four eligibility outcomes.

Description: Register, login, logout; middleware that sends users to the correct zone by role.
Acceptance criteria: Applicant cannot open /admin; unauthenticated user is redirected from /app.

Summary: Scheduled job: expiry to Stale and source re-fetch with hash compare
Description: Verified records pass to Stale when the validity date passes; changed source hash flags the record. Clock injection for tests.
Acceptance criteria: With a simulated later date the record is Stale; with a changed hash it is flagged.

Description: Tests that move the clock across validity dates and cycle ends.
Acceptance criteria: No record is shown as Verified after its validity date.

Summary: Verification queues API and conflict detection
Description: Queues for Stale, Missing, Unverified, Conflict. Conflict raised when two sources disagree for the same requirement.
Acceptance criteria: Each queue returns the right records on fixtures; resolving a conflict moves the record on.

Description: List/detail with filters by degree level and country, programme detail with requirements, statuses, sources and dates.
Acceptance criteria: Filters return correct subsets on the fixtures and the pilot data.

Description: Each programme has a template of expected requirement types; absent values are reported as Missing.
Acceptance criteria: Removing a value from a fixture programme makes it appear in the Missing queue.

Description: Check each record against the official page; fix or flag.
Acceptance criteria: Every record has a second checker recorded.

Description: Same as T-29 in the other direction.
Acceptance criteria: Every record has a second checker recorded.

Description: Fix the snapshot date so that evaluation runs against a stable dataset; keep evaluation profiles that were not used during development.
Acceptance criteria: Snapshot date documented; evaluation profiles are separate from development fixtures.

Description: Evaluate a requirement against a profile: Met, Not met, Pending, Unknown. Any non-Verified requirement yields Unknown.
Acceptance criteria: Property test: non-Verified records are never Met.

Description: Profile-programme-requirement cases covering all states and key edge cases; two annotators decide Met/Not met/Unknown from official sources at the fixed date.
Acceptance criteria: Cohen's kappa computed; disagreements resolved by a third reviewer.

Summary: Knowledge base ingestion: Verified records to indexed chunks
Description: Build text chunks with status, programme, requirement type and date metadata and a PostgreSQL tsvector index (no embeddings, plain PostgreSQL); re-index on status change.
Acceptance criteria: Chunks exist only for records usable as facts; a Stale transition removes or flags the chunk.

Summary: Retrieval: Verified-only, structured lookup plus full-text search
Description: Hybrid retrieval in plain PostgreSQL: parse the question into programme and requirement type and fetch records by SQL; fall back to full-text search (ts_rank, pg_trgm for typos) with the status filter inside the query. Empty result is a first-class outcome.
Acceptance criteria: No non-Verified chunk is ever returned in the test set; retrieval recall is measured on the AI evaluation set.

Description: Answerable, unanswerable, stale-data and conflicting-data cases with gold answers and expected citations. Final number to confirm with the supervisor.
Acceptance criteria: Set reviewed by a second annotator; stored in evaluation/.

Summary: Catalog page and programme page with requirements table
Description: Filters, requirement rows with value, status badge, source link and verification date. Works for guests.
Acceptance criteria: Every requirement row shows status, source and date.

Description: Four queues, record preview, actions to verify, mark stale, resolve conflict.
Acceptance criteria: Admin can move a record through its life cycle in the UI.

Description: Every result carries rule, applicant value, source and verification date.
Acceptance criteria: No result in the test set lacks the four items.

Description: Cover all operators, units, pathways, missing profile fields and every status.
Acceptance criteria: At least 100 tests pass in CI.

Description: Read/update with validation; each update triggers recomputation.
Acceptance criteria: Every field editable; a change recomputes eligibility and roadmap.

Description: Per-requirement outcomes plus an ordered list of gaps (Not met, Pending, Unknown).
Acceptance criteria: For 10 test profiles and 5 programmes every requirement has an outcome and an explanation.

Description: Gaps become tasks; offsets from verified deadline D; dependency DAG with topological ordering; a reason per task; 'verify or confirm this requirement' tasks for Unknown items.
Acceptance criteria: Every gap yields a task; no task is dated after its deadline.

Summary: Roadmap recomputation on profile or data change
Description: Event or on-demand recompute that keeps completed tasks.
Acceptance criteria: Changing a profile field or a requirement status updates the roadmap.

Description: Randomised profiles/deadlines: dependencies respected, nothing after deadline, unknown deadline handled explicitly.
Acceptance criteria: Zero dependency violations across the generated cases.

Summary: Advisor answer generation with mandatory citations
Description: Prompt over retrieved Verified chunks; answer must cite source and verification date.
Acceptance criteria: Every answerable test question returns at least one citation.

Description: Every cited chunk must exist in the retrieved set and support the stated fact; otherwise the answer is rejected and regenerated or refused.
Acceptance criteria: Fabricated citation in a test is caught.

Description: Refuse without a verified source; say outdated, missing or conflicting when that is the case; offer to request verification.
Acceptance criteria: Every unanswerable and stale question in the set is refused or warned.

Summary: Advisor API with persisted chat history
Description: Endpoint, history per user, link to the programme in context.
Acceptance criteria: History survives reload and is deleted with the account.

Summary: Eligibility summary and gaps on the programme page
Description: Personalised layer over the public requirements table for logged-in applicants.
Acceptance criteria: Outdated source shows Unknown, never Met.

Description: Ordered task list or timeline, reason per task, dependencies, link back to the gap.
Acceptance criteria: Open the reason for each task from the roadmap.

Summary: Onboarding screen: chat with editable profile panel
Description: Conversation on the left, extracted profile on the right, missing fields highlighted.
Acceptance criteria: Profile confirmed only after required fields are present.

Description: Rank catalog programmes for a profile using eligibility outcomes first. Needed for EQ1; currently no functional requirement covers recommendation. Confirm with the supervisor before treating as Must.
Acceptance criteria: Ranking returns top-5 with an explanation; baseline B1 implemented for comparison.

Description: Scripted run over the evaluation set with three repeats and baselines B4 (no retrieval) and B5 (no status filter, no citation validation); logs results.
Acceptance criteria: One command produces correctness, citation precision, hallucinated deadline rate, refusal accuracy.

Summary: Privacy and prompt-injection review of the AI layer
Description: Only fields needed for the task are sent to the provider; retrieved text cannot change system policy.
Acceptance criteria: Checklist completed; injection cases added to the AI test set.

Description: Next actions, shortlisted programmes, alerts for Stale/Unknown items.
Acceptance criteria: Dashboard reflects roadmap state.

Summary: Advisor chat UI with citation cards and refusal state
Description: Citation card shows source link and verification date; refusal state offers 'request verification'.
Acceptance criteria: Scenario S3 works end to end.

Summary: Admin: requirement editor, source snapshot viewer, audit trail
Description: Edit a requirement, compare the source snapshot, see the status history.
Acceptance criteria: All changes appear in the audit trail.

Summary: Admin: universities, programmes and templates management
Description: CRUD with validation.
Acceptance criteria: New programme can be added without code changes.

Description: All profile fields editable with visible effect on eligibility.
Acceptance criteria: Edit changes eligibility and roadmap.

Summary: Loading, empty and error states; responsive layout; accessibility pass
Description: Skeletons, retry, keyboard navigation, contrast checks.
Acceptance criteria: Core flows usable on a phone width and with keyboard only.

Summary: Shortlist, application checklist and deadline tracking
Description: Applications per programme with checklist from the programme's required items.
Acceptance criteria: Status changes persist; checklist reflects required items.

Description: Upcoming verified deadlines across the shortlist.
Acceptance criteria: Order and dates match the verified Deadline records.

Description: Email service integration and scheduler; configurable interval before a deadline.
Acceptance criteria: A reminder is sent at the configured interval (tested with a fake clock and a sandbox mailbox).

Description: Delete profile, chat history and account on request.
Acceptance criteria: Deleting an account removes profile and chat history (verified by test).

Description: Onboarding to profile, eligibility to roadmap, advisor answer and refusal.
Acceptance criteria: All three scenarios pass in CI against the fixtures.

Summary: API integration tests with a test database and role matrix
Description: Endpoints, DB constraints, permissions.
Acceptance criteria: Every route has a role test.

Description: Two annotators label profile-programme pairs; Precision@5, recall@5, nDCG@5 against B1.
Acceptance criteria: Results table with agreement statistic.

Summary: EQ2 run: accuracy, macro-F1 and false Met rate
Description: Run the engine against gold cases and the baseline B2.
Acceptance criteria: Report with confidence intervals; false Met rate stated honestly.

Summary: EQ3: expert rating of five roadmaps
Description: Mentor or supervisor rates completeness, ordering and actionability.
Acceptance criteria: Ratings recorded; dependency violations counted.

Summary: EQ4 protocol, consent form and participant recruitment
Description: Within-subject crossover, at least 8 participants, counterbalanced order, no personal identifiers stored. Needs supervisor approval.
Acceptance criteria: Protocol approved before the first session.

Description: Task time, completeness vs gold checklist, errors, confidence; Wilcoxon signed-rank.
Acceptance criteria: Analysis script and results table; limitations stated.

Description: Five core tasks, observation and SUS questionnaire.
Acceptance criteria: SUS reported with the agreed sample size.

Summary: Run EQ5 AI evaluation and report
Description: Three runs, Wilson 95% intervals, McNemar test against B4.
Acceptance criteria: Report includes failed cases.

Description: Compile EQ1-EQ5 against baselines, threats to validity, limitations.
Acceptance criteria: All targets are marked met or not met honestly.

Description: Password hashing, token handling, role checks, repository scan.
Acceptance criteria: Checklist passes; scan finds no keys.

Description: Hosting for the demonstration, environment variables, seeded pilot data.
Acceptance criteria: Public or supervisor-accessible URL; reset script.

Summary: Performance measurement on the demo environment
Description: Pages within 2 s; advisor within 10 s on the pilot dataset.
Acceptance criteria: Measurements recorded with environment description.

Summary: Final documentation: README setup and test instructions, architecture update, ADRs
Description: Documentation matches the implementation, including final technology choices.
Acceptance criteria: A new person can run and test the project from the README.
